full_judgment: 2. This Court on 8-11-2010 passed an order of arrest of the vessel 'MV BK Ace', now lying at the outer anchorage of Chittagong Port on the prayer of the plaintiff LMJ International Limited, which instituted the instant Admiralty Suit on the ground that the plaintiff imported 28,500 MT of Bulgarian wheat from the defendant No. 5 Messrs Soared SA for onwards supply to the Director General, Ministry of Food & Disaster Management Government of People's Republic of Bangladesh, under a contract No. DGOF /DOP /EP/Wheat-35 (Quotation)/2010-1698, dated 22-9-2010, and the said consignment was loaded on board the defendant No. 1 vessel 'MV BK Ace' at the load port of Varna, Bulgaria which reached the Chittagong Port on 5-11-2010. But although the plaintiff submitted original two bills of leading dated 12-9-2010 to the shipping agent of the Vessel, yet the defendant vessel failed to discharge the cargo and in the meantime twenty days have elapsed after tendering the notice of readiness by the defendant vessel on 8-10-2010, for which under compelling circumstances and due to suffering huge financial loss and injury for delay in discharging the cargo the plaintiff submitted a claim of Taka 77,46,56,784 to the owner of the vessel and that the being not been paid or denied within a reasonable period the plaintiff instituted the instant Admiralty suit with the prayer for a decree directing the defendants to release/ discharge of 22,428 MT Bulgarian wheat to the plaintiff in terms of the bills of leading, dated 12-9-2010 and letter of credit dated 10-9-2010 and also for a decree for a compensation at a total sum of US $ 9,833,685 equivalent to BD Taka 77,46,784 together with 20% interest per annum till the date of filing of the suit and also interest pendentelity at the rate of 20%.
